title: Cover Letter
intro: I’m a software engineer focused on test automation, developer tools, and game systems. I build reliable test frameworks and developer workflows that scale across teams.
paragraphs: At Blizzard I led automation efforts across multiple AAA game titles, building frameworks and tools that reduced manual verification time and increased test coverage. I enjoy breaking down large testing problems into small, automatable pieces and working closely with engineers to close the loop on quality.

At Dexcom, I created CI-driven test suites for embedded and cloud components, improving release confidence during regulatory cycles. I’ve worked across UI, API, and backend tests, and I prioritize maintainability and fast feedback for engineers.

I’m excited about roles where I can pair strong engineering with product sense: shipping developer-facing tools, building robust automation, and mentoring engineers to deliver higher quality software faster.
highlights: Designed and implemented a cross-team test framework that reduced flaky test noise by 40%.
Built an internal dashboard to visualize test-health metrics and prioritize reliability work.
Led a migration from legacy scripts to a typed test harness with CI integration, shortening iteration time by 30%.
closing: Thank you for taking the time to review my application. I’d welcome the opportunity to speak and share more about my work.
